Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely chose Peter Bjorn and John as the “performer of Falling Out,” incorrectly asserting it was the earliest album and proceeding from the band’s origin (Stockholm) to “Stockholm Palace.” This ignored Serena Ryder’s 1999 album “Falling Out” and her birthplace (Toronto), which leads to the correct castle, Casa Loma. The misselection and reliance on band origin instead of the correct performer’s birthplace caused the wrong final answer.
